nli_model_info.model_description: Vishleshan NLI v1 — engineered-feature multiclass NLI classifier

dataset_provenance.dataset_name: MultiNLI (Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference) Validation Subset
dataset_provenance.source: NYU Machine Learning for Language Group
dataset_provenance.authors: Adina Williams, Nikita Nangia, Samuel Bowman
dataset_provenance.evaluation_scope: Controlled 30-pair evaluation split (10 Entailment, 10 Contradiction, 10 Neutral)

label_definitions.ENTAILMENT: The premise guarantees the truth of the hypothesis.
label_definitions.CONTRADICTION: The premise guarantees that the hypothesis is false.
label_definitions.NEUTRAL: The premise gives no conclusive proof for or against the hypothesis.

level_b_company_conflict_evaluation.explanation: No open peer-reviewed public dataset exists specifically for corporate intelligence evidence-pair NLI conflicts. Synthetic examples are reserved strictly for unit testing.

phase_5b_conclusion.status: PHASE 5B: IMPLEMENTED BUT RESEARCH VALIDATION PENDING
phase_5b_conclusion.justification: Level A benchmark on controlled 30-pair MultiNLI evaluation split completed successfully using scikit-learn standard multiclass metrics (Weighted F1 strictly in [0,1]). Level B domain-specific validation remains pending due to absence of public corporate NLI conflict dataset.
